caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a female figure standing on a rectangular, tiered wooden base. The figure has medium brown skin and long dark brown hair, and wears a red dress with a yellow trim at the hem and sleeves. Over the dress is a green apron-like garment, tied with a blue sash that is knotted at the front. The figure's legs are clad in cream-colored leggings, and her feet are in dark shoes with blue bands. On her head is a feathered headdress with feathers in red, green, blue, and tan colors. In her raised right hand, she holds green leaves or tobacco. Her left arm is extended downward, balancing something rounded and brown in her open palm. Around her neck, she wears a necklace with a yellow pendant. The background is plain off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature appears in small print at the bottom right.
title: Indian
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
